name: Cable Plug Hole Cover / Grommet / Bushing (Parametric)

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric cable plug designed to cover an enclosure hole while allowing a cable to pass through. It consists of a thin, flat circular base with three snap-fit cantilever catch posts arranged in a circular array. A U-shaped slot is cut from the outer edge of the base to the center, providing a channel for a cable to slide in easily.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric cable plug in OpenSCAD that covers a larger hole in a case while allowing a cable to pass through. It should feature a flat round base, adjustable snap-fit catch posts to secure it to the case, and a slot-style cable channel from the edge to the center. Ensure parameters exist for case hole diameter, cable diameter, case thickness, base overlap, and the number of snap catches.
captions.factory: The design starts with a union of a base cylinder and a rotate_extrude polygon that creates a continuous ring profile for the snap catches. A difference operation then subtracts a cylinder and a cube to form the central cable hole and its entry slot. Finally, a loop rotates a custom 'wedge' module (made from a difference of cubes) to cut away sections of the continuous ring, leaving behind the specified number of individual snap-fit posts.
